summary: This Docker file stage sets up a production-ready web server using nginx. It starts with a lightweight nginx image based on Alpine Linux, then copies pre-built website files from a previous build stage into the directory where nginx will serve them.

explanations.1: This pulls the nginx web server image from Alpine Linux 3.19 (a very small, minimal operating system), and gives this stage the name 'production' so other stages can reference it.
explanations.4: This copies the website files that were built in an earlier stage called 'building_production' from the /opt/docusaurus/build folder into /usr/share/nginx/html, which is where nginx looks to serve files to visitors.
explanations.6: This sets the working directory (the default location for any subsequent commands) to where the website files now live, so nginx knows that's where its content is.
